_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Lebanon covering Phoenician city-states (Byblos, Tyre, Sidon), invention of alphabet, Persian/Hellenistic periods, Roman Berytus law school, early Christianity (Maronites), Arab conquest, Crusader County of Tripoli, Mamluk/Ottoman rule, Druze-Maronite conflicts, Mount Lebanon Mutasarrifate, French Mandate, independence 1943, National Pact confessionalism, 1958 crisis, Palestinian refugee crisis, civil war 1975-1990, Taif Agreement, Syrian occupation, Cedar Revolution 2005, 2006 Israel-Hezbollah war, Beirut port explosion 2020, and ongoing political-economic crisis.

religion.note: 18 officially recognised sects; confessional power-sharing (President=Maronite, PM=Sunni, Speaker=Shia); no census since 1932 to avoid upsetting sectarian balance; estimated Muslim majority since mid-20th century

ethnic_groups.name: Arab (Lebanese)
ethnic_groups.notes: Majority identify as Lebanese Arab or Phoenician heritage; Maronite Christians historically dominant in Mount Lebanon; sectarian identity (Sunni, Shia, Druze, Maronite) often supersedes ethnic identity; urban Beirut cosmopolitan

ethnic_groups.name: Armenian
ethnic_groups.notes: Genocide survivors 1915; Bourj Hammoud/Anjar communities; distinct language/churches (Apostolic, Catholic); politically represented (Tashnag/Hunchak); declined from 6%

ethnic_groups.name: Kurdish
ethnic_groups.notes: Small community; some stateless; Beirut/northern Lebanon

ethnic_groups.name: Other (Assyrian, Turkmen, Dom)
ethnic_groups.notes: Small minority communities; plus ~1.5 million Syrian refugees and ~200,000 Palestinian refugees (not counted in citizen demographics)

country_profile.notes_unique: Byblos among world's oldest continuously inhabited cities; Phoenician alphabet ancestor of most modern scripts; 'Paris of the Middle East' (pre-war Beirut); 2020 Beirut port explosion (one of largest non-nuclear explosions in history); banking secrecy collapse 2019; 1.5M Syrian refugees (~25% of population); Cedars of God (UNESCO); Hezbollah dual state-within-a-state

trade.notes: Huge trade deficit; historically services/banking economy; Beirut port partial function; forex crisis limits imports; informal/smuggling economy large.

infrastructure.notes: 24/7 power cuts (state provides 2-4 hrs/day); entire country on generators; Beirut port destroyed (2020 blast); no functioning railway; infrastructure deteriorating rapidly.

governance_indices.notes: Confessional power-sharing system (18 sects); presidential vacuum (2022-2025); systemic corruption; state capture by sectarian elites; Taif Agreement framework.

country_profile.national_motto: All of us for the nation, for the sublime, for the flag
country_profile.national_anthem: Kulluna lil-watan (All of Us! For Our Country!)

geography.terrain: Narrow coastal plain; Lebanon Mountains; Bekaa Valley; Anti-Lebanon Mountains east
geography.notes: Smallest mainland Asian country in Middle East; Cedars of Lebanon iconic; Mediterranean climate; Bekaa Valley fertile; massive Syrian refugee population.

economy_extended.notes: Worst non-war economic collapse in 150 years (World Bank); currency lost 98% value; banking sector frozen; Ponzi-scheme economic model collapsed 2019; massive brain drain.

health.notes: Healthcare system near-collapse; 40%+ doctors emigrated since 2019; medicine shortages; previously best healthcare in Arab world; Beirut blast 2020 destroyed hospitals.

food_agriculture.notes: Bekaa Valley breadbasket; high food import dependency; 2020 grain silo destruction (Beirut blast); wine industry (oldest in world); cannabis legalization 2020.

security_stability.internal_conflicts: Hezbollah/Israel conflict; sectarian tensions; Syrian spillover
security_stability.border_disputes: Shebaa Farms (Israel/Syria); maritime border with Israel (resolved 2022)
security_stability.notes: Hezbollah military wing militarily powerful; 2023-2024 Israel-Hezbollah conflict escalation; Syrian refugee crisis (25% of population); civil war legacy (1975-1990); UNIFIL presence.

environment_climate.notes: Cedars of Lebanon UNESCO sites; waste crisis (trash on streets/sea); Litani River pollution severe; Beirut blast environmental damage; quarry damage to mountains.

demographics_extended.notes: Diaspora 2-3x resident population; massive brain drain since 2019; sectarian identity primary; Palestinian/Syrian refugees ~30% of population; AUB historically prestigious.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
comparative_rankings.notes: Severe economic crisis since 2019; historically 'Switzerland of the Middle East'; confessional political system.

world_heritage_sites: Ouadi Qadisha and Forest of the Cedars of God
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: L'Orient-Le Jour (French); Daily Star (English); LBC, MTV, Future TV; most vibrant media in Arab world (historically).
cultural_heritage.notes: Phoenician heritage; Byblos (oldest continuously inhabited city claim); cedar symbol; 18 religious sects; devastating 2020 Beirut explosion.

energy.notes: Chronic electricity crisis; private generators supplement grid; economic collapse worsened supply; potential offshore gas (Block 9); Syrian crisis strain.

human_rights_gender.notes: Confessional system entrenches sectarian division; no civil marriage law; refugee crisis (1M+ Syrians); economic collapse; Beirut port explosion accountability.

legal_system.legal_tradition: Civil law (French-influenced); religious courts for personal status
legal_system.sharia_applicability: Personal status for Muslim communities (Sunni and Shia separate courts)
legal_system.customary_law_role: Religious community courts handle personal status for 18 sects
legal_system.notes: Oldest constitution in Arab world; confessional power-sharing (Taif Agreement 1989); Court of Cassation; 15 separate personal status laws by sect.

tourism.notes: Tourism devastated by 2019 economic crisis and 2020 Beirut explosion; historically major tourism economy; Baalbek temples rival Parthenon.

public_transit_systems: No formal mass transit; service taxis and buses
transport.notes: No operating railway; destroyed in civil war; Beirut port partially rebuilt after 2020 explosion; MEA (Middle East Airlines) national carrier.
